company_news.headline: Cintas Corporation Announces Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Results
company_news.summary: CINCINNATI, July 15, 2026--Cintas Corporation (Nasdaq: CTAS) today reported results for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter ended May 31, 2026. Revenue for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 was $2.91 billion compared to $2.67 billion in last year’s fourth quarter, an increase of 8.9%. The organic revenue growth rate for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, which adjusts for the impacts of acquisitions and foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations, was 8.4%.
